source_note: The first three timing runs preceded addition of the L40S SKU predicate. Their selected paths are unchanged; final source schedule and public graph replay were rechecked on all four GPUs.
reference_positions_note: Exact query sets are retained in raw captures; seeds and the unchanged positions() routine reproduce them. This summary records counts and SHA256 of JSON-encoded position lists.

framework_review.retained_stack_reason: Same qualified Torch 2.13.0+cu130 stack as baseline campaign and officially supplied NATTEN wheel; avoids changing the SDPA comparator while isolating scheduling. No claim for alternate framework releases.

recovery_notes: An early qualification helper failed before tests because repository PYTHONPATH was missing; its failed setup and source were retained separately. The fixed runner and final suites passed.
arithmetic: Current 3D two-term P forward, normalized dQ, reconstructed dK, column-staged statistics. Tile controls change scheduling only. No previous single-P control in this comparison.

measurement.boundary: Complete warm eager forward attention call with resident inputs, including required mask/stack/copies/layout and Python work. Synchronized wall time is primary. No decoder, projections, RMS/RoPE, backward, graph, compilation or transfer timing.
measurement.inputs: Synthetic normalized Q/K, Q pre-scaled by 0.125, API scale 1.0, B1/D64, contiguous BTHWHD.
measurement.accuracy: Native CPU FP64 on identical rounded inputs; output/component per-head norm limits FP16 0.5%, BF16 1%. Directed fixtures separately check prescribed rounded equations using actual O.
measurement.runtime: Qualified pinned stack retained for same-stack baseline/candidate comparisons.

traversal_work.scope: Analytical scheduled score-pair counts from exact traversal with outer rejected blocks omitted; no measured instruction or utilization claim. One batch/head, includes within-tile masked pairs.

telemetry.scope: Coarse pre/post-call snapshots, not continuous clocks/power or utilization counters.

full_coordinate_accuracy.scope: Full-coordinate native CPU FP64 on identical rounded random inputs. Explicit compact control exercises reference-sized volumes outside production dispatch. Per-head FP16 0.5%, BF16 1% separately for output and each gradient.
